name: date-time-picker
title: Date Time Picker
description: One moment: the DatePicker trigger and the TimePicker field in one named group, editing an instant on the reader's clock, with a default time for a day picked alone.

meta.whenToUse: A date with a time of day — a due time, a meeting start, a Date and time field — shown and edited in the reader's time zone.
meta.whenNotToUse: A day with no time (DatePicker), a time with no day (TimePicker), or a range (DateRangePicker).
